settings.title: Find A Tune Shop Near You

settings.text: At Ski Pro, we know great ski and snowboard service takes time to get right. Our skilled technicians work carefully to make sure your gear performs it's best when you hit the slopes.

Turnaround times are subject to change based on seasonal demand and service complexity. We operate on a strict first-in, first-out basis to ensure fairness for all customers. We do not take reservations for standard services. All quoted timeframes are estimates and may vary during peak ski season. During busy periods like holiday weekends and powder days, demand for ski tuning, waxing, and repair services increases significantly. Each of our locations can service hundreds of skis and snowboards each week, but during high volume times, services in some instances can take over a week. We recommend bringing your equipment for service during off-peak times when possible, for faster turnaround.

For skiers and snowboarders who need immediate service, we offer a "Rush" surcharge for priority processing. Rush service moves your equipment to the front of the queue while maintaining our quality standards. This premium service is perfect for last-minute tune-ups, emergency repairs, race preparation, and urgent binding adjustments.

Quality ski service involves multiple steps that each need proper time to work correctly. Our Future Wax technology needs time to heat and penetrate deep into your ski base. Edge sharpening requires precision for smooth, controlled turns. Epoxy repairs must cure completely for strong, lasting fixes. Stone grinding creates the perfect surface texture for your skiing style, and binding mounts need careful measurement and testing for your safety.

We recommend scheduling major services well before planned ski trips. For routine maintenance like basic waxing, same-day service is often available during slower periods. Our commitment to quality ensures your equipment performs at its peak on the mountain.

settings.title: What to Expect & Preparing Your Equipment

settings.text:
1. Drop Off

Bring your equipment to our shop where one of our experienced technicians will assess what services your gear needs. We'll discuss your skiing style, snow conditions, and any specific concerns you have.

2. Quote & Timeline:

Bring your equipment to our shop where one of our experienced technicians will assess what services your gear needs. We'll discuss your skiing style, snow conditions, and any specific concerns you have.

3. Payment & Paperwork:

Payment is due at drop-off, and we'll complete any necessary liability forms and waivers at that time. Quick and easy.

4. Service Work

Once you approve the work, our technicians get started using our professional-grade equipment and techniques. Your gear receives the attention it deserves.

5. Pickup:

Your gear will be ready for pickup on the due date given during the initial paperwork process. Feel free to give your local shop a call to verify if your gear is done.

settings.title: What to Bring for Different Services

settings.text:
Binding Mounts & Calibrations: You'll need to bring one boot (either left or right), your skis, and bindings. This ensures perfect fit and proper safety settings for your specific boots.

General Tuning & Repairs: Just bring your skis or snowboard. We handle everything else.

Snowboard Services: If possible, removing bindings beforehand saves time and helps us deliver better results, but it's not required if you prefer to leave them on.

Don't worry about extensive cleaning or preparation - we'll take care of that as part of our service. However, please remove excess mud or debris before bringing your gear in. This helps us assess your equipment properly and gets your service started faster.

Our team is here to make the process easy and get you back on the mountain with confidence in your equipment.

settings.title: Do you take reservations for services?
settings.content: No, we operate on a strict first-in, first-out basis to ensure fairness for all customers.

settings.title: When do I pay for services?
settings.content: Payment is due at drop-off along with any necessary liability forms and waivers.

settings.title: Are turnaround times guaranteed?
settings.content: No, all quoted timeframes are estimates and may vary significantly during peak ski season based on demand and service complexity.

settings.title: Can I get rush service?
settings.content: Yes, we offer priority "Rush" service with an additional surcharge that moves your equipment to the front of the queue.

settings.title: What if you find additional damage during service?
settings.content: We'll contact you for approval before performing any additional work beyond the original quote. In some cases, we may need to stop work if equipment is deemed unsafe.

settings.title: Do you service all types of bindings?
settings.content: No, we cannot service non-indemnified bindings. Only bindings with current manufacturer indemnification are eligible for mounting, adjustment, and calibration services.

settings.title: Is Custom Tune Up available at all locations?
settings.content: Level of customization varies by location. Call ahead to discuss your specific needs and confirm availability.

settings.title: Do you work on vintage or older equipment?
settings.content: We assess older equipment on a case-by-case basis. Some vintage bindings and skis may not be serviceable due to safety and liability concerns.

settings.title: What if my equipment is deemed unsafe?
settings.content: We reserve the right to refuse service on equipment with structural damage or safety concerns that cannot be adequately repaired.

settings.title: Frequently asked question
settings.content: We do not service cross country skis. For mountaineering equipment, proper knowledge and maintenance is critical to user safety in extreme environments. Due to the life-safety nature of mountaineering gear, we cannot provide services for specialized equipment that we are not experts in. While we're happy to answer general questions, mountaineering users must be fully responsible for understanding and servicing their own equipment.

settings.title: What do I need for binding mounting?
settings.content: You must bring one boot (either left or right), your skis, and bindings to ensure proper fit and safety settings.

settings.title: Do I need to clean my equipment first?
settings.content: Just remove excess mud or debris so we can properly assess your equipment.

settings.title: Can I supply my own wax?
settings.content: We use professional-grade wax systems optimized for our equipment. For specific wax requests, please discuss with our technicians during drop-off.
